ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixels (estimated 85% coverage) with high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips and as scattered mottling across both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity (black/dark-gray) regions across the fluke center. High-intensity (white) contiguous blobs are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes. Sparse white mottling is distributed across the mid-section of the left lobe and the lower-central region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations extracted along the entire trailing boundary. Amplitudes vary between 5-15 pixels. High-density peaks are visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-curving trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in pointed, upwardly swept lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 10-12 circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (scars) primarily located in the central-left lobe and lower-medial right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) are visible on the upper-left lobe running diagonally from the trailing edge toward the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular serration/amputation-like trauma visible on the outer margin of the right distal tip.
